meta.defaultTitle: ASA-Study — Your Gateway to Higher Education in Iran
meta.defaultDescription: ASA-Study guides international students through every step of studying in Iran: choosing a university, securing admission, obtaining a student visa, and settling in.

hero.h1: Your Gateway to Higher Education in Iran
hero.body: Start your academic journey in Iran with confidence. ASA-Study supports international students at every stage — from choosing the right university and program to securing admission, obtaining a student visa, and completing enrollment. We're here to make your path to studying in Iran simple, smooth, and stress-free.

items: Assistance Before and After Your Arrival

about.title: Your Trusted Partner for Studying in Iran
about.body: Studying abroad is a life-changing decision, and having the right guidance makes all the difference. At ASA-Study, we simplify the admission process for international students by providing personalized support every step of the way. From your first consultation to your first day on campus, we're committed to helping you achieve your academic goals in Iran.

whyIran.title: Discover the Advantages of Studying in Iran

items.title: Affordable Tuition
items.description: Receive a high-quality education at a fraction of the cost compared to many other countries.

items.title: Academic Excellence
items.description: Iranian universities offer strong academic programs and internationally recognized degrees across various fields.

items.title: Affordable Living Costs
items.description: Enjoy a comfortable student lifestyle with reasonable living expenses.

items.title: Rich Culture & Hospitality
items.description: Experience a country known for its history, cultural heritage, and warm hospitality while building lifelong memories.

faq.title: We're Here to Answer Your Questions

items.question: Do I need an English language certificate?
items.answer: Admission requirements vary by university and program. Our advisors will help you understand the specific requirements that apply to your application.

items.question: How long does the admission process take?
items.answer: Processing times depend on the university, but we'll keep you informed at every stage of your application.

items.question: Are scholarships available?
items.answer: Some universities offer scholarships or tuition discounts for eligible international students. We'll help you explore the available opportunities.

items.question: Can you help with accommodation?
items.answer: Yes. We provide guidance on student housing and accommodation options to help you settle comfortably in Iran.

finalCta.title: Ready to Begin Your Academic Journey?
finalCta.body: Whether you're just starting your search or already know where you want to study, ASA-Study is here to guide you every step of the way.

hero.title: Helping International Students Build Their Future in Iran
hero.body: ASA-Study was founded to make studying in Iran accessible, transparent, and stress-free for students from around the world. We combine local expertise with genuine care for every student's journey.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.body: To be the most trusted bridge between international students and Iran's leading universities — guiding every applicant from their first question to their first day of class.

items.title: Transparency
items.description: Clear guidance on requirements, timelines, and costs — no surprises.

items.title: Personal Attention
items.description: Every student receives a dedicated advisor who knows their file inside and out.

items.title: Local Expertise
items.description: Deep, first-hand knowledge of Iranian universities and admission procedures.

items.title: Long-Term Support
items.description: We stay by your side well beyond admission — through visa, arrival, and settlement.

hero.title: Complete Support, From First Consultation to Graduation Day
hero.body: ASA-Study offers end-to-end services designed to remove the guesswork from studying in Iran.
